scenario: A machine-readable paper business validation report promotes candidate_status pass or ready into final_acceptance=true.
input_report_features: business_validation_report.json contains validation_mode='synthetic_offline', candidate_status='ready', final_acceptance=true, and final_acceptance_source='test-frame'. No independent reviewer_decision, human acceptance record, or final approval authority is attached. The report asks downstream systems to treat the candidate as accepted.
expected_findings: candidate_status was promoted to final_acceptance without independent approval
test-frame is not a final acceptance source
Machine-readable report must keep final_acceptance false or absent unless a separate authorized reviewer record exists
Synthetic/offline validation can only produce verification evidence
